newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE may drift slowly up to 4,740.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE may drift slowly up to 4,740.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may drift gently up to around 4,740 on Thursday, technical analysts said.
Market dynamics have shifted a gear and the frantic pace from last week has changed to a more leisurely, cruising sojourn, they added.

The FTSE remains in an uptrend with ascending trendlines connecting the market's recent intra-day highs and lows and these allow it to roam within a 30 point daily range. Sectors to benefit today should include oils and pharmaceuticals.
By 0726 GMT, at the pre-market open, the FTSE was indicated down 4.8 at 4,720.0.
The FTSE's 10 day historic volatility is giving a high but not extreme reading at 14 percent, having been as high as 15.7 percent earlier in the year.
The readings imply there is now a greater probability that the market's intra-day range will shorten over the near-term.

Despite small setbacks such as on Wednesday -- when the index slipped 14.8 points, the FTSE's trendlines still indicate the market possesses sufficiently positive characteristics which should take it a little higher near-term, analysts said.
